newsitem.title: FRANCE: Telepiu 96 loss 387 mln guilders - Canal Plus.
newsitem.headline: Telepiu 96 loss 387 mln guilders - Canal Plus.

text.p: French pay television group Canal Plus said on Monday Italian pay TV firm Telepiu -- a 45 percent owned unit of the Nethold group with which Canal Plus is merging -- made a loss equivalent to 387 million guilders in 1996.

Canal Plus executive Laurent Perpere, who is in charge of finances at the French group, announced the loss to a meeting of analysts and journalists, saying it was linked to an increase in programme acquisition, marketing and promotion costs.
It compared to a loss of the equivalent of 59 million guilders in 1995.
Canal Plus was presenting details of the figures behind its merger with Nethold, a Dutch-South African group controlled by Richemont and MIH Holdings.
